question: May worship be performed according to one's own personal will?
premises: Worship is prescribed as something to be performed.
The text addresses the goddess regarding this rule.
Acting by one's own will is contrasted with prescribed performance.
inference: Worship must be performed as prescribed and not according to one's own will.
plain_english: O goddess, worship is to be performed as prescribed; one should not do it according to one's own will.
